12345678901.name: Amaze Glow Run The Park
12345678901.description: My first official 5K. Went out too fast, faded on the last kilometre, and somehow still signed up for another one the same week.

12345678902.name: Mangkunegaran Run
12345678902.description: The sub-30 finally happened here. Pacing was boring and disciplined — exactly what it needed to be.

12345678903.name: Soekarno Run SOC
12345678903.description: Everything clicked. Legs felt light from the first kilometre, and 25:36 still feels a little unreal.

12345678904.name: Solo Run Fest
12345678904.description: First 10K, first time dealing with fuel and heat over an hour. Finished just under the hour, which was the whole goal.

12345678905.name: Gapuro to Gapuro
12345678905.description: Not a fast one. A long, honest run that taught me more about pacing than any of the shorter races did.

12345678906.name: Mangkunegaran Run
12345678906.description: The one I trained a whole block for. Even splits, no wall, and a finish I'd been picturing for months.
